summary: Assess contract claims, organize evidence and plan arbitration decisions. Explore this practical five-day course and review the outline.
lede: International arbitration training helps in-house counsel, contract managers and claims professionals assess disputes arising from contract performance. They map contract events and notice issues, organize documentary evidence, assess claim quantum, plan procedures and hearings, and report settlement options, using ICC, UNCITRAL and IBA rules as practical references.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare, assess or support international commercial arbitration cases arising from contract performance, project delivery and cross-border supply.
modules: ICC Arbitration Rules and Case Triage
IBA Evidence Rules and Digital Records
IBA Conflicts Guidance and Hearing Preparation
ICC Case Synthesis and Settlement Reporting
prerequisites: Working familiarity with commercial contracts, contract performance records or claims administration is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
